collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After sharing food with a traveler from across the island, a villager wonders how distant people welcome strangers.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After sharing food with a traveler from the other side of the island, (name1) wonders whether distant people welcome strangers with gifts.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager imagines distant hosts offering food and shelter to travelers.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A skeptic notes that generosity might depend on how much people have to share.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests that strangers might be treated carefully, even fearfully, in some places.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar adds that caution and kindness can exist side by side.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village discusses its own customs and finds them good.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A villager admits they once ignored a stranger and decides to do better.
